body:
Adds an `experiments/figure.py` and `utility.svg` to six ambient projects, so their home pages show a figure. Each figure is grouped bars (mean held-out utility per hour, std whiskers over 20 seeds) for the uninformed-prior rows, parsed from the committed `results.txt`; no numbers are retyped and no results change. `PROJECTS.md` milestone 9 progress updated. `python site/build.py` prints ok (422 projects) and each of the six pages embeds its figure.
